about.lead: From the database to the interface, end to end.
about.p1: I'm Felipe Teixeira Farias, a full stack developer at Softwrench, a company based in Scottsdale, USA. I work fully remote with an international team.
about.p2: Day to day I build complete features on a web platform for maintenance and asset management (CMMS): C# and .NET services with SQL Server on the back end and AngularJS on the front end.
about.p3: I hold a technical degree in web development from ETEC and I'm studying Information Systems at UNASP. On the Student Council I built leadership and teamwork skills. Off the clock I play guitar and drums.
